html:
Focus are proud to have partnered with the Cashflow management system CaFE to help you manage your cashflow better.

CaFEfully integrates with FreeAgent and highlights any impending cashflow issues before they occur.

It will help you to make financial decisions, such as who to pay, who to chase and when you might need to borrow money.
